description: This file defines a React functional component called ContactForm used for capturing user messages and submitting the form data to an API endpoint. It manages form state, validation, submission status, and error handling.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input changes, updating the form state.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form inputs (name, email, message) before submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, performs validation, sends data to the API, and manages response.
